wildlife.hook: Start where the forest is still breathing.
wildlife.why: Not the Serengeti first. Half the world's mountain gorillas live on three volcanoes, and you walk to them.

mountains.why: Eighty per cent of Africa above three thousand metres is in one country, and the Simien escarpment has gelada on it.

rainforest.hook: Go west of the famous forests.
rainforest.why: Korup is older than the Congo basin's and has a canopy walkway thirty metres up, with almost nobody on it.

coast.hook: Skip the resorts on the other coast.
coast.why: Two thousand kilometres of Indian Ocean, most of it still without a road, and dhows instead of speedboats.

culture.why: Cape Coast and Elmina are kept as they were, the Ashanti court still sits at Kumasi, and there is a band on every night.

food.hook: Eat where the bread is still communal.
food.why: Tagine cooked slowly, bread baked in the neighbourhood oven, and a souk that sells to the people who live there.

heritage.why: People have travelled to see this for two and a half thousand years, and the Valley of the Kings is still painted floor to ceiling.

adventure.hook: Take the road with nobody on it.
adventure.why: The best self-drive country on the continent: gravel, dunes, and the darkest measured night sky anywhere.
